candidates.description: This vector activates on common Latinate and Germanic verb and noun prefixes ending in double consonants.
This vector represents the character sequence 'oc' and its variations appearing at the beginning or within words.
This vector represents Italian verb infinitive endings or words sharing common Italian suffix patterns.
This vector represents morphological components and linguistic roots containing the letter sequence "tr".
This feature vector activates on subwords and root tokens related to Latin-derived prefixes and suffixes, particularly variations of the roots for "sever" and "elevate" across multiple languages.
This vector activates on tokens containing specific rhyming or root patterns ending in an 'om' or 'am' sound.
This feature detects the letter sequence "erv" or phonetically similar subword fragments across various root words and proper names.
These tokens represent morphological roots and stems of complex Latinate and Greek-derived English verbs, nouns, and adjectives.
This vector activates on tokens containing the Spanish or Italian verb root "ven" (to come) or words containing the character sequence "ven".
This vector represents subword tokens containing the character sequence "ul".
